methodology.as_of_rule: Every figure carries the platform's own timestamp; quote it as of that time, never as current advice.
methodology.index: Each fund is a price-weighted index of its constituents (sum of prices ÷ divisor), quoted in dollars at 2 decimals. The M&A Ripple index is the value of $100 deployed at inception, settling on daily equity closes.
methodology.returns: Return is measured since the fund's own inception from real market prices with timestamped entries. One fund is an exception and says so in its return_basis: FTA Fund — Cryptos is pro-forma, today's composition applied across the full period since inception, the same construction its page and chart state, so the stretch before last_composition_change was not held in that form. Short books report the FUND return: a falling index is a positive return.

status.paper: trades simulated; takes no investment yet
status.standing: live but not yet allocated capital

methodology.withheld: Short-book legs are aliased and open M&A ripple baskets are not disclosed while positions are open (published shorts are squeeze bait). Capital amounts, AUM and allocations are never published; the mandate and deployment are given as percentages.
methodology.execution: Long-side execution runs through the platform's brokerage partner, Brokerage100. Fill counts below a portfolio's leg count are implementation shortfall (Perold 1988), not a caveat on the record.
methodology.not_advice: Data is informational. The Tuatara Hedge Fund remains highly experimental. Nothing here is a recommendation to any client.

result.page_note: This fund is highly experimental. Every figure on this page is a live measurement, not a track record.
